new_title: Learning coefficients of deep ReLU networks
statement: For a deep ReLU (or tanh) network of fixed widths, a realizable true parameter w0 and inputs from a compactly supported law with positive density, compute the real log canonical threshold of K(w) = E[(f_w(x) - f_w0(x))^2] at w0 as a function of the widths and of the true network's structure. The deep linear case is known (Aoyagi; Pepin Lehalleur and Rimanyi: half the codimension of the fibre); an exact algorithm exists only for two-parameter models.
sources: arXiv 2411.19920 (Pepin Lehalleur, Rimanyi), 2608.20183; abstracts read 11 Nov (NEW_DL_CANDIDATES.tsv N05).

new_title: The neural feature ansatz for a gradient-trained two-layer network
statement: For f(x) = a^T sigma(W x) trained by gradient descent from small initialisation on a single-index target y = g(<theta, x>) with Gaussian x, prove that W^T W at the end of training is, up to a vanishing error, proportional to a power of the average gradient outer product E[grad f(x) grad f(x)^T] (the ansatz says the square root), or give a counterexample. Exact analysis exists only for linear recursive feature machines.
sources: arXiv 2610.09196 (Cheng, Kiani, Lu, Radhakrishnan); one search only, 11 Nov (N06).

new_title: The limit of iterated rectified flow
statement: For an absolutely continuous law mu on R^d, d >= 2, coupled with the standard Gaussian, does the k-fold rectified-flow coupling converge as k grows; is the limit straight (non-crossing transport paths); and is it the Brenier optimal transport coupling? Two steps are not straight in general: Pham, Roy, Rinaldo and Sarkar characterise when two-step rectified flow is straight for smooth strongly log-concave densities and Gaussian mixtures.
sources: arXiv 2610.36090v2 (Pham, Roy, Rinaldo, Sarkar), abstract read 11 Nov (N04).

new_title: A chain-of-thought learning separation for composition in S_5
statement: For the word problem of S_5 (composing n permutations), gradient-trained transformers with chain-of-thought tokens are known to learn state tracking. Prove the matching lower bound: gradient descent on the same constant-depth architecture without intermediate tokens needs superpolynomially many samples or steps (a gradient or statistical-query lower bound, not only the conditional TC0 versus NC1 expressivity separation).
sources: arXiv 2511.07378 (Huang, Wen, Singh, Chi, Chen), 2508.08222 (Yang, Huang, Liang, Chi); abstracts read 11 Nov (N03).

new_title: The limit direction of sharpness-aware minimization on two-layer ReLU networks
statement: On linearly separable data, with the practical unnormalised l2 perturbation of fixed radius, does the normalised parameter of SAM on a two-layer homogeneous ReLU network converge in direction, to a KKT point of which margin problem, and does it differ from the max-margin KKT direction that gradient descent reaches (Lyu and Li; Ji and Telgarsky)? Diagonal linear networks are done (Moon, Si, Yun).
sources: arXiv 2603.08290 (Moon, Si, Yun), 2410.14802 (Li, Zhang, He); abstracts read 11 Nov (N02).
